data.event_date: opening its doors later this month
data.status: Gas Burgers is a new retro-style burger restaurant occupying a converted former gas station in North Haven. It will open later this month at 277 State Street, with an exact date to be announced via social media. The restaurant will feature smash-burgers, milkshakes, ice cream, outdoor fire pits, bocce, cornhole, and live music, and will be owned by North Haven resident Chris Allen.

Mercado and Sips is a new dirty soda and drink shop in Naugatuck, Connecticut. It opened on June 6th at 134 Church Street, near Church Street Creamery, with hours of 11am–8pm on June 6th and 10am–6pm on June 7th. The shop offers dirty sodas, coffee, espresso drinks, lemonade, teas, baked goods, and locally made goods for sale.

data.store_name: Sky Tower Lobby, Mohegan Sun, Uncasville, Connecticut
data.status: The Tiki Bar at Mohegan Sun is a seasonal pop-up experience returning for another summer, offering tropical cocktails and entertainment in the Sky Tower Lobby. It is scheduled to open June 19th and run until September 6th. The article also notes the current seasonal Secret Garden Bar pop-up is open through June 14th before closing for the season.

data.store_name: Sky Tower Lobby, Mohegan Sun, Uncasville, Connecticut
data.status: The Secret Garden Bar is a springtime seasonal pop-up at Mohegan Sun featuring flowers surrounding the bar. The article notes it will be open through June 14th, after which it closes for the season. It is mentioned within the Tiki Bar article as context for the upcoming seasonal transition.

Da Andrea Pizzeria - Trattoria is a new Italian restaurant opening at 110 Boston Post Road in Westbrook, Connecticut, a site previously occupied by Shore Pub and at least four other restaurants over the last decade. It will open June 10th, serving Italian classics, high-quality pizzas, and house-made dishes, with gnocchi-making classes planned for the future. The restaurant is owned by Anisa Moloney and Chef Michele Iuliano, who also own Luzzo's and Gnoccheria in New York City.
